name: filter_try_catch
description: A try/catch that actually throws and catches per document. The divisor comes from params because Painless constant-folds 1/0 and rejects it at compile time. Exception construction is expensive; this is the template that says how expensive.

script.source: try { int z = 1 / params.zero; } catch (ArithmeticException e) { return true; } return true;
